continuity_scope: FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail, Patch 7.0 content baseline (official North American English release, 2 July 2024). This is a live-service snapshot, not a claim about later Dawntrail patches, other expansions, regional localizations, or player-created characters.

The Lodestone: Patch 7.0 Notes (North American English)
FINAL FANTASY XIV: Dawntrail official Jobs page (North American English)

coverage_rule: Five named individual characters selected from the Patch 7.0 official Key Characters page because their contemporaneous profiles directly establish distinct source-native comparison dimensions: Wuk Lamat (succession claimant/ruling family), Erenville (gleaner and guide), Krile (Lalafell, two organizations, Echo and pictomancy), Zoraal Ja (First Promise and Landsguard commander), and Gulool Ja Ja (Dawnservant/founder/ruler). The player-created Warrior of Light is explicitly excluded as an avatar role rather than a stable named character.
omissions: The player-created Warrior of Light/avatar, whose identity, appearance, race, and jobs are player-selected; retained only as a role/mechanical reference in source scope.
Other Patch 7.0 Key Characters (Koana, Thancred, Urianger, Bakool Ja Ja) because this is a deliberately small, attribute-diverse cohort rather than the full cast.
The 'Enigmatic Maiden,' because the selected official page does not give a stable personal name.
All later patches, other expansion eras, quest-only NPCs, named summons, organizations, races, tribes, worlds, crystals, jobs, artifacts, and systems as character nodes.
uncertainties: FINAL FANTASY XIV is live service: the Lodestone Patch 7.0 notes display an update timestamp of 12 August 2025, while this pass uses only their explicit Patch 7.0 statements and the Patch 7.0 special-site profiles; later changes are out of scope.
The selected evidence is the North American English localization. Japanese and other localizations may use different wording and are not silently merged.
Profiles are promotional, spoiler-conscious summaries. They establish only the attributes stated there; route outcomes, later identities, and unshown relationships are not inferred.
The official page says Gulool Ja Ja 'appears to have' a past connection to Galuf; that qualified statement is not recorded as a relationship.
evidence_basis: First-party Square Enix / FINAL FANTASY XIV special-site character profiles for character claims and relationship; official Lodestone patch notes for the 7.0 system boundary; official jobs page for source-native job terms; official release-date announcement for date. No fan wiki or unofficial game database was used.
